exposure: Time period relative to COVID-19 pandemic (pre-pandemic, during strict isolation, post-restrictions)
outcome: Frequency of RSV infection requiring NICU admission
Clinical severity of RSV infection (need for intubation, non-invasive ventilation, supplemental oxygen, inhaled bronchodilator drugs, length of hospital stay)
cohort: 208 community-acquired RSV-infected neonates admitted to the NICU, with a median age at admission of 26 days.
finding: Following the COVID-19 pandemic and removal of public health restrictions, the frequency and severity of RSV infection significantly increased in newborns, affecting even full-term babies without comorbidities.
